customManagers.description: Release versions pinned as Dockerfile build args, marked with a renovate comment.

packageRules.description: Docker image patch releases merge themselves as soon as the pytest check is green. Minor and major stay as PRs: they have needed config changes, and database migrations only go forward (GoToSocial is the usual example). Only fully-pinned semver tags qualify; a moving tag like postgres:16 or :latest never produces a patch update.

mcp-kagisearch stays on Python 3.12: kagimcp 1.0.0 declares Requires-Python ==3.12.*, and 1.1.0 pulls pydantic-core, which has no cp315 wheels. Renovate bumped this to 3.15 twice (#308, #321) and broke the build each time.
